C-REVIEW-CURRENT-BOUNDARY-2-6ACE9713.Summary: First of three smaller successor slices replacing the superseded `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-REVIEW-CURRENT-BOUNDARY-1-217D3F0D` bundle. This slice is **review-only**. Following the current-only CLI policy in `AGENTS.md` and the withdrawn compatibility campaign in `docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/grace-implementation-queue.md:154-156`, it (1) makes the global `MustExist` review discover active `plan.xml` files before reading any plan content, so `runPatternDetectors`, unscoped `runReview`, and selected-active `runReview` read no unrelated archive XML, and removes the `review.historical-path-absent` finding and its catalog guide; (2) replaces the scoped review's archive-dependent amendment measurement with the existing `amendmentCountAudit` not-run absence — a non-empty current-only policy reason and a matching absence record, with no numeric re-ratification/depth keys, no fabricated zero, and no `ran` status — and stops invoking `readAmendmentInstrument` from `runReview`; and (3) fixes the two selected-review location predicates in `src/review/core.ts` that test an absolute-path substring for the archive marker, to use the actual project-relative bundle phase, while preserving genuine selected applied and abandoned-archive audit semantics. It preserves the existing D8 admissible code set and family-A pattern set and asserts whole-population catalog/localization exclusive-or coverage, retiring the literal total/excluded-length pins and their stale explanatory comments. Exactly four paths change across two modules (`M-REVIEW`: `src/review/core.ts`, `src/review/catalog.ts`, `src/review/core.test.ts`; `M-LOCALIZE`: `src/verification/localize.test.ts`). It overturns `C-HISTORICAL-ASSERTION-REVIEW-4-5D40885D`'s choice to keep unrelated-archive detection as informational review notices under the later current-only policy, and it deliberately overturns only `C-AMENDMENT-COUNT`'s `AC-REVIEW-AUDIT` scoped-review projection (`spec.xml:607-620`); that decision's distinction between status text and review-audit surfaces and its honesty bar remain. It does not claim all CLI consumers are archive-free: the separate `ngrace status` surface was already assigned to a dependent policy slice by `C-CURRENT-VALIDATION-BOUNDARY`. It declares no `Pays` and makes no governed record-system write; the sanctioned close still performs this bundle's ordinary lifecycle writes. `README.md` is unchanged by this slice (its measured footprint row belongs to the third slice); `examples/` is unchanged.

Goals.Goal: In `src/review/core.ts`, discover active `plan.xml` files before reading any plan content in the global `MustExist` scan, so no unrelated archived plan is opened by `runPatternDetectors`, unscoped `runReview`, or selected-active `runReview`, and remove the `review.historical-path-absent` producer and its archive branch. Preserve active `BaselineAssertions` and `TargetAssertions` absent-path errors, including undeclared/unexempt target claims, the declared-future target exemption, and the current identity helpers. The intentionally selected archive record stays readable by its own selected consumer.

In `src/review/core.ts`, report the scoped-review amendment measurement as `amendmentCountAudit` `status="not-run"` with a non-empty current-only policy reason and a matching absence record, without numeric re-ratification/depth keys, without a fabricated zero, without `ran`, and without invoking `readAmendmentInstrument` from `runReview`. Unscoped review keeps its existing `not-run` reason naming the missing `--change`.

In `src/review/core.ts`, replace the two selected-review location predicates that test an absolute-path substring for the archive marker with a check of the actual project-relative bundle phase, preserving genuine selected applied and abandoned-archive audit semantics and the other current detectors and process audits, except the deliberate scoped amendment-audit absence in `AC-AMENDMENT-AUDIT-ABSENCE`.

In `src/review/catalog.ts`, remove the `review.historical-path-absent` guide; in `src/review/core.test.ts` and `src/verification/localize.test.ts`, retire the obsolete literal total/excluded-length pins and their stale explanatory comments and titles, while preserving the D8 admissible code set, the family-A pattern set, and the whole-population catalog/localization exclusive-or relation.

C-REVIEW-CURRENT-BOUNDARY-2-6ACE9713.Problem:
The current-only policy in `AGENTS.md` and the withdrawn compatibility campaign in `docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/grace-implementation-queue.md:154-156` withdraws historical archive compatibility: older archive contents are passive LLM evidence, not current operational inputs. The superseded predecessor `C-REVIEW-CURRENT-BOUNDARY-1-217D3F0D` was split into three smaller slices; this bundle is the review-only first slice. Four defects remain in the current product and two archived decisions must be answered.
First, `src/review/core.ts:508-567` globally discovers `changes/**/plan.xml`, parses archived contents, and emits `review.historical-path-absent` from archived `MustExist` values; `runReview` invokes that global detector before the selected audits (`:1561-1590`). Measured 2026-10-06 by the authority's call-through read spies on a fresh synthetic project (`/private/tmp/neo-grace-review-current-boundary-20261006/read-stack.json`): the MustExist scan reads an archived plan twice through `readGraceXmlArtifact` at `core.ts:512` and `extractObservedWriteScopeFromPlan` at `:519`, and both a neutral and a misleading parent `changes/archive` root still read it; unscoped `runReview` and selected-active `runReview` read it too. Discover active plans before reading any plan content in the global `MustExist` scan; remove the obsolete archive-notice producer and guide; preserve active `MustExist` refusal, including Baseline and undeclared/unexempt Target claims, the declared-future target exemption, and the current identity helpers.
Second, scoped review still measures archived amendment counts. With `--change`, `runReview` calls `readAmendmentInstrument` (`core.ts:1811`) and reports `amendmentCountAudit` `status="ran"` with numeric `reRatificationCount` and `supersedeChainDepth` (`:1804-1812`), reading archived predecessor bytes through the shared predecessor map. That is archive-dependent and contradicts the review read boundary. Replace it with the existing `amendmentCountAudit` not-run absence: a non-empty current-only policy reason and a matching absence record, no numeric keys, no fabricated zero, no `ran`, and no `readAmendmentInstrument` call from `runReview`. This overturns only `C-AMENDMENT-COUNT`'s `AC-REVIEW-AUDIT` scoped-review projection (`spec.xml:607-620`); its unscoped `not-run` behavior, surface distinction, and honesty bar remain, and no ledger API or duplicate counting algorithm is introduced.
Third, two selected-review location predicates test an absolute-path substring for a `changes/archive` marker: `isAbandonedArchiveBundle` (`core.ts:1488-1494`) and `auditCloseEvidenceUnevaluated` (`core.ts:1899-1913`). A project root whose directory names happen to contain `changes/archive`, or a bundle path assembled differently, can be misclassified. Determine archive phase from the actual project-relative bundle path instead, preserving genuine selected applied and abandoned-archive audit semantics.
Fourth, the `review.historical-path-absent` guide in `src/review/catalog.ts:338-354` and the literal catalog-length pins and stale comments in `src/review/core.test.ts:2478,3116,3122,4887` and `src/verification/localize.test.ts:433,439` encode the retired behavior and a projected count. Remove the guide and retire the pins while preserving the D8 admissible set, the family-A set, and the whole-population catalog/localization exclusive-or relation.
Counterweights answered, not ignored. `C-HISTORICAL-ASSERTION-REVIEW-4-5D40885D` (`spec.xml:3-31`, `plan.xml:57-59`) deliberately kept F16 relocation/foreign-ID detection as informational notices; this change explicitly overturns that unrelated-archive detection choice under the later current-only policy, answering it with active-plan refusal. `C-AMENDMENT-COUNT` (`spec.xml:607-620`) is overturned only in its scoped-review projection; its distinction and honesty remain. The separate `ngrace status` archive-dependent surface is not touched and was already assigned to a dependent policy slice by `C-CURRENT-VALIDATION-BOUNDARY`.

Assumptions.Assumption: The two location predicates can be repaired inside `src/review/core.ts` by deriving archive phase from `path.relative(root, bundlePath)` and prefix-matching the canonical `.ngrace/changes/archive/` segment, without a new helper export and without changing `resolveChangeBundle` or `src/grace-cursor.ts`.

Removing the `readAmendmentInstrument` call leaves no other consumer of that export inside `src/review/core.ts`; if the import becomes unused it is removed within the same file. No ledger API changes.

The shipped XML parser counts artifact structure (the parser-derived census). The runtime catalog/localization populations and relations are measured through the real exported catalog/localization functions, including `allReviewCodes()`, after implementation; no post-change total is projected here.
